_note: What people say. A placeholder starter set: rewrite freely. Where there's a list, one line is picked per person, the same each time. Markers filled in by the game: {name} the speaker, {role} what they do, {here} this place, {region} its region, {place} a real place in the world (hearing it teaches you that topic), {kind} what kind of place it is, {direction} and {distance} from here to it, {person:ROLE} the name of whoever has that role here (teaches you them as a topic; a line naming a role that isn't here is skipped), {person} the person asked about, {where} where they can be found. Wary people only say one sentence of a line: the first, or the second if the first just repeats the question ('{place}?'). Every rumor (topics.news.rumors) needs {place}, so it can be followed. rumorOdds: rumors favor places in the same region (that many times as likely) and nearby ones (a place distanceFalloff tiles away is half as likely as one next door). Only use characters the 3x5 font has: capitals, digits and . , ' ? ! : - + / ( ) $ #.
